question: Should autonomous imported jobs permit duplicate or superseded closes in issue-only clusters without first producing a fix when no cluster member has a security signal?
rationale: Tests establish that the implementation follows its proposed rules, but they cannot decide whether broadening autonomous close eligibility is the intended operational policy.

options.title: Accept bounded issue-only closes
options.body: Merge the current policy so ordinary issue-only duplicate clusters can close without a fix while mixed and security-sensitive clusters remain fix-first.

options.title: Add an explicit opt-in
options.body: Require a separate importer option for issue-only no-fix closes so operators select the broader policy per import wave.

options.title: Retain universal fix-first
options.body: Keep requiring a fix path before autonomous duplicate closure for all eligible cluster types.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded issue-only closes
recommendation.body: Merge the current policy so ordinary issue-only duplicate clusters can close without a fix while mixed and security-sensitive clusters remain fix-first.
